terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: The rules for using the Onlynify UI website, CLI and premium blocks.

sections.heading: 1. About these terms
paragraphs: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Onlynify UI website, CLI and premium blocks (the "Service"), provided by [Registered company name] ("Onlynify", "we", "us"). By creating an account, signing in or using the Service you agree to these Terms. If you use the Service for an organisation, you confirm you are authorised to accept these Terms on its behalf, and "you" means that organisation.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts and access
paragraphs: You must give accurate registration details and keep them up to date. You are responsible for everything done through your account, so keep your password and any one-time codes private and tell us at once if you suspect unauthorised access.
Access is role-based. Account owners and administrators decide who in their organisation can see and change which data, and are responsible for granting and removing access promptly.

sections.heading: 3. Acceptable use
paragraphs: You must not:
bullets: break any law, or upload content that is unlawful, defamatory, obscene or infringes anyone's rights;
send spam or unsolicited bulk messages through the Service;
try to access another customer's data, probe or break our security, or bypass usage limits;
upload malware, or interfere with the Service's normal operation;
resell or sublicense the Service without our written permission;
use the Service to collect personal data without a lawful basis.

sections.heading: 4. Onlynify UI licences
paragraphs: The Onlynify UI kit (stylesheet, scripts, Web Components, tokens and CLI) is open source under the MIT licence. You may use it free of charge in any project.

Premium blocks are licensed, not sold. A Pro licence covers one developer and a Team licence covers up to five; either can be used in unlimited projects, including commercial and client work for Team.
bullets: You may modify premium blocks and ship them inside your own products and client projects.
You may not resell, redistribute or publish premium blocks as a UI kit, template or theme, or put their source code in a public repository.
Licence keys are personal to the licence holder. Sharing a key beyond its seats is a breach of these Terms, and we may revoke the key.

sections.heading: 5. Payment and refunds
paragraphs: Licences are a one-time payment in Indian Rupees including GST, processed by our payment gateway partner. They include updates to premium blocks for the life of the product.
If a licence is not right for you, email us within 14 days of purchase for a full refund. We will then revoke the licence.

sections.heading: 6. Your content and data
paragraphs: You keep ownership of the data and content you put into the Service ("Customer Data"). You give us permission to host, process and display it only to provide, secure and support the Service. How we handle personal data is explained in our Privacy Policy.
You are responsible for having a lawful basis, including any consent required under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, for the personal data you upload about other people.

sections.heading: 7. Third-party services
paragraphs: Some features rely on third-party providers, such as payment gateways, SMS, chat and email delivery, and hosting. Their own terms apply to their services. We are not responsible for outages or errors on their side, though we choose them carefully and will help you resolve problems.

sections.heading: 8. Our intellectual property
paragraphs: The Service, the Onlynify name and logos, and all software and designs (other than open-source components under their own licences) belong to Onlynify. These Terms do not give you any right to use our trademarks.

sections.heading: 9. Availability and changes
paragraphs: We aim for high availability and announce planned maintenance in advance where we can, but we do not guarantee the Service will be uninterrupted or error-free. We may change or improve features, and we will give reasonable notice before removing a feature you pay for.

sections.heading: 10. Suspension and termination
paragraphs: You may stop using the Service at any time. We may suspend or close an account that breaks these Terms, puts other users at risk, or is required to be closed by law. Where we can, we will warn you first and give you a chance to export your data.
After an account is closed, we keep Customer Data for 30 days so you can export it, unless the law requires otherwise. After that we delete it, as described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 11. Disclaimers and limitation of liability
paragraphs: The Service is provided "as is" and "as available". To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential losses, or for lost profits, revenue or data. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us for the Service in the 12 months before the claim.
Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

sections.heading: 12. Indemnity
paragraphs: You agree to compensate us for reasonable losses and costs arising from your breach of these Terms or from Customer Data that infringes someone's rights.

sections.heading: 13. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms. If a change is material, we will tell you by email or in the app at least 15 days before it takes effect. Continuing to use the Service after that date means you accept the new Terms.

sections.heading: 14. Governing law and disputes
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at [City], India have exclusive jurisdiction, subject to any consumer rights that cannot be waived. Before going to court, please contact us so we can try to resolve the issue.

paragraphs: [Registered company name], [Registered office address], India. Email: hello@onlynify.com. Grievance Officer: [Grievance Officer name] (hello@onlynify.com). We acknowledge grievances within 48 hours and aim to resolve them within 30 days.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How we collect, use and protect personal data in the Onlynify UI website, CLI and premium blocks.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy explains how [Registered company name] ("Onlynify", "we") handles personal data in the Onlynify UI website, CLI and premium blocks. Onlynify is the Data Fiduciary for the account, purchase and licence data described below.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: Depending on how you use the Service, we may process:
bullets: Account details: name, email and a scrypt hash of your password (never the password itself).
Purchases and licences: plan, amount, payment reference, licence key and the dates it was issued and used.
CLI usage: when a premium block is downloaded with your key, we record the block, the framework and the time, to prevent key sharing.
Security logs: IP address and request metadata used for rate limiting.

sections.heading: 3. How we use it
paragraphs: We use personal data only to:
bullets: provide the Service, including sign-in, role-based access, notifications, receipts and support;
process payments and keep accounting and tax records;
secure the Service, which includes detecting fraud, abuse and unauthorised access, and keeping audit logs;
improve the Service using aggregated, de-identified usage statistics;
meet legal obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis and consent
paragraphs: We process your data with your consent, which you give when you register or submit a form, or for legitimate uses the DPDP Act allows, such as keeping records required by law. You can withdraw consent at any time; this doesn't affect processing already done.

sections.heading: 5. Who we share it with
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with:
bullets: service providers who help us run the Service, such as hosting, payment gateways, SMS, chat and email delivery. Each is bound by contract to use the data only for that purpose;
people in your organisation, according to the roles your administrator assigns;
authorities, when the law requires it or to protect people's safety.

sections.heading: 6. How we protect it
bullets: Encryption in transit (HTTPS) and encryption at rest for integration secrets.
Passwords stored only as salted, slow hashes; sessions use short-lived tokens in HttpOnly cookies.
Role-based access control and per-customer data isolation (each customer's data is tagged with its workspace and checked on every request).
Audit logs of administrative actions, rate limiting and security headers.
We will notify affected customers and the Data Protection Board of India of a personal data breach as the DPDP Act requires.

sections.heading: 7. How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep personal data while the account or workspace is active. After it closes, we keep the data for 30 days so it can be exported, then delete or anonymise it. Exceptions are records we must keep longer by law, such as tax and accounting records, which we keep for up to 8 years.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: Under the DPDP Act you can:
bullets: ask for a summary of your personal data and how it is processed;
ask us to correct, complete, update or erase it;
withdraw consent;
nominate someone to exercise these rights if you die or become incapable;
raise a grievance with us and, if it isn't resolved, complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

sections.heading: 9. How to make a request
paragraphs: Email hello@onlynify.com. We may ask you to verify your identity before acting on a request.

sections.heading: 10. Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: We use only essential cookies: a session cookie that keeps you signed in, and a cookie that protects forms from cross-site attacks. We also save your theme choice in local storage. We do not use advertising cookies or sell browsing data.

sections.heading: 11. Where data is stored
paragraphs: Data is stored on servers in India where available. If a service provider processes data outside India, we make sure the transfer is allowed under the DPDP Act and protected by contract.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We will post any changes here and update the effective date. If a change is material, we will also tell you by email or in the app before it takes effect.

sections.heading: 13. Grievance Officer and contact
paragraphs: Grievance Officer: [Grievance Officer name], [Registered company name], [Registered office address], India. Email: hello@onlynify.com. We acknowledge requests within 48 hours and respond within 30 days.
